question: After the Q4 backend is converted from eager experimental pre-materialization to a single demand-driven concrete v4 backend, does real backend execution preserve route, acquisition, execution readiness, representation residency and eviction semantics, preserve correctness and every frozen generic-family oracle, and avoid any new backend-induced semantic drift?

criteria_provenance.note: Pass/fail semantics are inherited from the previous gate and the convergence contract; no threshold or semantic criterion is changed in response to the new execution outcome.

required_evidence: same-head v4 regression: 114688 family #1 decisions plus P8/I002/ANL64 oracles
A route with lifecycle NONE performs zero B allocation/materialization
P1/P3/P0 acquisition occurs only when selected by policy
B becomes routable only after exact identity validation
resident B positive-reuse route performs no reacquisition
EVICT releases B before A continuation
backend does not invent hidden retry or fallback
real-weight A and B component correctness remains within frozen gates
no new semantic dimension or family-specific branch is required in generic policy/binding
